messages:
maria: Quick check — marketplace + SI partners asked for an "exception lane" for next week's auth header rename. Can we scope what that actually means?

alex: by exception lane do they mean a compatibility proxy we run for them, or a soft-deprecation grace window?

maria: they asked for a short-lived proxy we host (30d) + telemetry on errors, and an SLA that the proxy is only for critical customers. also want a signed manifest for clients.

sourav: hosting proxies is fine but ops needs exact traffic shaping. what traffic cap do we commit to? also need to gate by feature-flag to avoid blast radius.

james: ops ask +1 on feature-flag. suggest: 200rps total across partners, burstable to 1k for 10m. Canary first 48h with a single SI, then open lane.

maria: good plan. partners want no code change on their side while proxied. can we do header rewrite + JWT pass-through?

alex: header rewrite feasible. sample config: 

```
proxy_rule {
  match: "Authorization: X-Old"
  rewrite: "Authorization: X-New"
  preserve_jwt: true
}
```

alex: we should add a validation step that rejects tokens older than XX hours to avoid replay.

sourav: Agree. Also add telemetry tag `partner_exception_lane` and emit these metrics: `proxy.requests`, `proxy.fails`, `rewrite.errors`. Hook into console dashboard.

maria: partners also requested a rollback playbook and a comms template for customers if proxy goes flaky. @james can you draft the ops runbook?

james: on it. I’ll include runbook sections: incident detection, reroute to pass-through, rate-limit lift, and partner notification templates. ETA EOD today.

harmon: security note — this proxy touches auth headers. Need a short threat model and to ensure keys never persist. Also KMS audit on rewrite service.

maria: good catch. harmon can you sign off on secure-by-default config? We need that before we tell partners yes.

harmon: will review. quick checklist: no logs of raw auth, TLS mTLS to partner endpoints, HMAC on manifests, and yearly key rotation (or match partner KMS).

partner-bot: [automated] New partner ticket created: PART-8342 "exception lane request" — assigned to partnerships.

maria: Action items: 1) james draft runbook (ETA EOD) 2) sourav / ops to confirm caps + FF gating 3) alex to prototype rewrite plugin and non-persisting keys 4) harmon security sign-off 5) me to draft partner comms + SLA snippet.

alex: one more thing — let's add a telemetry SLA breaker: if `rewrite.errors` > 1% for 5m, auto-disable proxy and notify partners.

sourav: agreed. ops will wire the breaker and dashboard alert.

maria: thanks all. I’ll update PART-8342 and ping partners once we have sign-off. :thumbsup:

james: filing the runbook now: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-exception-lane (draft)

maria: perfect — closing loop after security sign-off.
